remarks: Charming In-Town Colonial Near New Canaan's Best Amenities  Nestled in the heart of New Canaan, this classic colonial offers the perfect combination of charm and convenience. Centrally located on a beautifully landscaped .58-acre lot in the desirable 1/3-acre zone, this home is just moments from New Canaan's stellar public schools, the vibrant village center, and quick access to the Merritt Parkway.   Featuring a new roof (2014) and new siding (2013), this well-maintained property is move-in ready with room to make it your own. Whether you're looking for proximity to schools, dining, and shopping or an easy commute, this location has it all. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy in-town living with a suburban feel.
